name: terminal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
L=Path.cwd();ex=['MANIFEST.json','terminal_manifest.receipt.json','terminal_manifest.output.txt'];files=[]
for p in sorted(L.rglob('*')):
 if not p.is_file():continue
 n=str(p.relative_to(L))
 if n in ex:continue
 b=p.read_bytes();files.append({'path':n,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
assert json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text())['mismatches']==[]
assert len(json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text()))==20
v={'algorithm':'SHA256','files':files,'terminal_noncircular_self_exclusions':ex,'exclusion_reason':'Manifest cannot hash itself; terminal runner writes its receipt and output only after this child completes. All earlier completed receiptJSON files are included.','frozen_after':'frozen-after.json','qualified_survivors':0,'accepted_credit':0}
s=json.dumps(v,indent=2);subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),'MANIFEST.json'],input=s,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
for x in files:assert hashlib.sha256((L/x['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==x['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files':len(files),'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256((L/'MANIFEST.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'frozen_bindings':13,'mismatches':0,'qualified_survivors':0,'self_exclusions':ex}))
